description: Autonomous security pipeline that receives SIEM alerts, performs reconnaissance, exploits vulnerabilities, generates patches, and verifies remediation

nodes.name: ingress
nodes.description: Parses the incoming SIEM alert, extracts target IP, sets initial trace_id and iteration_count

nodes.name: scout
nodes.description: Runs nmap port scan, HTTP probes, log analysis, then uses LLM to identify vulnerabilities

nodes.name: summarizer
nodes.description: Summarizes scout findings into concise topography report

nodes.name: investigator
nodes.description: Analyzes vulnerability and crafts exploit payload based on topography and failure history

nodes.name: sandbox
nodes.description: Validates and executes the exploit payload in an isolated sandbox, searches output for flag pattern

nodes.name: evaluator
nodes.description: Routes based on outcome: flag captured → architect, retry available → investigator, max retries → END

routes.investigating: retry loop (back to investigator, max 10 iterations)

nodes.name: architect
nodes.description: Generates remediation patch for internal targets or exploit walkthrough for external/HTB targets

nodes.name: human_approval
nodes.description: Pauses execution for human review of the proposed patch before applying

nodes.name: verifier
nodes.description: Applies the patch, restarts victim, re-runs exploit to confirm vulnerability is blocked

nodes.name: rollback
nodes.description: Restores original source code on verification failure
